subject: Fixed an issue with errors not being correctly reported after completion requests in functions within nested calls (#54944)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Completion requests inside functions in nested calls cached resolved signatures and function types, so later checking missed errors; the fix disables caching of function-like types during the run.
